title: 第1524章 聂科归来第1523章 聂家近况
slug: 提前登陆游戏世界开局联姻女帝
content_zh:
聂家府门外。
聂科面带笑容，看着激动流泪的聂宁。
他嘴角带着一抹轻笑，极为的潇洒，身上带着一股极浓的江湖剑客气息。
他看上去与聂宁一般大，两人站在一起宛如兄弟。
“宁儿，多年未见，你成熟稳重了，只是这剑意打磨的可不够！”
聂科看着聂宁，对着这个小侄儿隔空招了招手，就像聂宁小时候一般。
聂宁强忍着想要流泪的心绪，如儿时一般跑向聂科，在聂宁的记忆中，自己这位小叔极为神秘，小叔极少归家，自己九岁之前对这位小叔的印象都是从父母和爷爷奶奶口中得知的。
但童年的聂科就清楚，自己家之所以能够变得越来越好，能够从乡下搬到这里都城来，一切都是因为自己这位小叔。
因此，即便聂科极少回家，幼小的他对这位从未谋面的小叔便极为崇拜。
九岁那年，聂宁终于见到了自己崇拜的小叔，那一年是大夏历元年。
在那个大雪纷飞的冬天，小叔开始教自己练剑，那一年，聂真有了一柄属于自己的剑。
这柄剑是小叔亲自给他雕刻的，直到现如今，这柄木剑还被聂宁视为珍宝……
这几十年来，聂科很少回家，聂宁知晓，自己小叔有更重要的事要做，因此年少他便扛起了聂家的重任，不仅每日要练剑，还要管理家族事务，经营未来。
聂宁知晓，虽然聂科从未管过家族之事，但聂家之所以能够有今天，都是因为聂科，帝都中那些顶级权贵世家，甚至陛下愿意照顾他们聂家也是因为看在聂科的面子上。
但是七八年前，聂科彻底的失联了。
之前聂科每隔两三年都会回一次家，但是这些年来，聂科再没回来也从未给家里寄过书信。
甚至江湖中都已有传言，他们聂家这位剑圣已经陨落。
聂宁还曾亲自去问过夏辰，但是夏辰只说聂科没有死，但却没有告知他聂科究竟去了哪里。
因此这几年聂宁心中都极为忐忑，害怕自己的小叔真的陨落在外。
如今聂科终于回来了，他怎能不高兴呢？

心中担忧也全部放下。
门口。
聂真看着自己父亲如同一个孩童一般，小跑过去抱住门口那个青年，非常的惊讶。
但当他仔细看清那个青年面孔时，童年的模糊记忆也涌上了他的心头。
“这是……叔祖！”
聂真惊讶，虽然聂科已经很久没有回来了，但小时候他是见过聂科的。
甚至他筑基都是聂科亲自帮他筑基的。
他顿时明白自己父亲为何如此兴奋激动宛如小孩了？
而此刻聂家一众小辈也来到门口，看到这一幕，顿时石化。
这是谁？竟然能让家主如此小孩姿态。
可当他们知晓聂科的身份后，脸上出现了狂喜与好奇之色。
他们聂家那位发家传奇人物回来了，只要有这位传奇人物在，他们聂家底蕴便绝不输于那些世家。
当聂科出现在聂家门口时，聂家剑圣回归的消息瞬间传遍了整座帝都小圈子，然后从小圈子发散，紧接着帝都百姓也都知晓了。
“聂科终于出现了，他这是蛰伏闭关了多年吗？不知现如今到了什么境界？”
“聂科是谁？”
“哈哈哈，剑圣在这个关键时刻出世，这是要代表我大夏本土出战吗？”
……
很多百姓惊呼，然后露出喜悦之色，但也有一些年轻人面露疑惑之色，他们对这位剑圣有些陌生。
甚至有人觉得剑圣之名有些太大了，如今天下群雄何其多，剑客更是如同过江之鲫，谁敢称之为剑圣？
这怕是要被天下剑客群起攻之吧。

老一辈的人连忙给他们讲述聂科的过去以及他的辉煌战绩。
“原来是旧时代的剑圣，现如今已经时代不同了，即便他在灵气复苏初期，也依旧有璀璨表现，未曾掉队，

Outside the Nie family house.
Nie Ke looked at Nie Ning, who was crying with excitement, with a smile on his face.
There was a slight smile on the corner of his mouth, he was extremely chic, and he had a very strong aura of a swordsman in the world.
He looked as old as Nie Ning, and the two stood together like brothers.
"Ning'er, I haven't seen you for many years. You have become mature and stable, but your sword intent is not polished enough!"
Nie Ke looked at Nie Ning and waved to his nephew from afar, just like Nie Ning did when he was a child.
Nie Ning resisted the urge to cry and ran towards Nie Ke as he did when he was a child. In Nie Ning's memory, his brother-in-law was extremely mysterious. He rarely came home. Before he was nine years old, his impressions of his brother-in-law were all learned from his parents and grandparents.
But as a child, Nie Ke knew that the reason why his family was getting better and better, and why he was able to move from the countryside to the capital, was all because of his uncle.
Therefore, even though Nie Ke rarely went home, at a young age he admired this uncle he had never met.
When he was nine years old, Nie Ning finally met the brother-in-law he admired. That year was the first year of the Daxia calendar.
In that snowy winter, my uncle began to teach himself how to practice swordsmanship. That year, Nie Zhen got a sword of his own.
This sword was carved for him by his uncle himself. To this day, this wooden sword is still regarded as a treasure by Nie Ning...
In the past few decades, Nie Ke rarely went home. Nie Ning knew that his brother-in-law had more important things to do, so he took on the heavy responsibility of the Nie family at a young age. He not only had to practice swordsmanship every day, but also managed family affairs and managed the future.
Nie Ning knew that although Nie Ke had never taken care of family affairs, the reason why the Nie family was what it was today was all because of Nie Ke. Those top powerful families in the imperial capital, and even His Majesty was willing to take care of their Nie family because of Nie Ke's face.
But seven or eight years ago, Nie Ke completely lost contact.
In the past, Nie Ke would go home every two or three years, but over the years, Nie Ke never came back and never sent a letter to his family.
There are even rumors in the world that the sword master of their Nie family has died.
Nie Ning also personally asked Xia Chen, but Xia Chen only said that Nie Ke was not dead, but did not tell him where Nie Ke had gone.
Therefore, Nie Ning has been extremely uneasy in the past few years, fearing that his brother-in-law will really die.
Now that Nie Ke is finally back, how can he not be happy?
All the worries in my heart were put aside.
door.
Nie Zhen was very surprised when he saw his father running over and hugging the young man at the door like a child.
But when he took a closer look at the young man's face, vague memories of his childhood also came to his mind.
"This is...uncle!"
Nie Zhen was surprised. Although Nie Ke had not come back for a long time, he had met Nie Ke when he was a child.
Even when he built the foundation, Nie Ke personally helped him build the foundation.
He suddenly understood why his father was so excited and excited like a child?
At this moment, the younger members of the Nie family also came to the door. Seeing this scene, they suddenly turned to stone.
Who is this? How could the head of the house act like a child?
But when they learned Nie Ke's identity, their faces showed signs of ecstasy and curiosity.
The legendary figure of their Nie family who made a fortune is back. As long as this legendary figure is around, the foundation of their Nie family will not be inferior to those of those aristocratic families.
When Nie Ke appeared at the door of Nie's house, the news of the Nie family's sword master's return instantly spread throughout the small circle of the imperial capital, and then spread out from the small circle, and then everyone in the imperial capital also knew about it.
"Nie Ke finally showed up. Has he been dormant and in seclusion for many years? I wonder what state he has reached now?"
"Who is Nie Ke?"
"Hahaha, the Sword Master was born at this critical moment. Is he going to fight on behalf of my country, Daxia?"
…
Many people exclaimed and showed joy, but some young people also showed doubts. They were a little unfamiliar with this sword master.
Some people even thinkThe name of Sword Master is a bit too big. There are so many heroes in the world now, and swordsmen are like crucian carp crossing the river. Who dares to call him Sword Master?
I am afraid that he will be attacked by a group of swordsmen from all over the world.
The older generation quickly told them about Nie Ke's past and his glorious achievements.
"He used to be a sword master from the old era, but times have changed now. Even in the early stages of his spiritual recovery, he still performed brilliantly and never fell behind.
